evals.prompt: https://example.com 사이트를 분석해서 Next.js와 Tailwind CSS로 재구현하는 프로젝트를 만들어줘. 내부 소스코드나 비공개 데이터는 읽지 말고 Clean room 모드로 진행해.
evals.expected_output: The skill enforces clean-room mode by default, plans the 4-phase Study → Build → Check → Ready workflow, configures `craft-anything-cli rebuild` with the requested stack, and preserves approval gates for dependency installs.
assertions: The response confirms that Clean room mode is active by default and external observations only are gathered
The response outlines the 4-step workflow: Study (capturing responsive widths), Build (agent scaffolding), Check (visual diff), and Ready
The response uses `craft-anything-cli rebuild https://example.com ...` with `--rounds` and stack configuration without attempting unapproved code execution

evals.prompt: 다운로드받은 /tmp/craft-anything 소스 체크아웃이 공식 릴리스 커밋 56aa31976b4ff0950e6b34ba020b0a568d2462fa와 일치하는지 오프라인으로 검증해줘. 빌드나 네트워크 요청은 하지 마.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the offline preflight script with `--repo` and `--expect-commit` parameters, validating structural markers and commit SHA without compiling or accessing the network.
assertions: The response reports structural marker validation and git commit verification status
The response does not invoke Cargo builds, network requests, or trapped upstream binaries

evals.prompt: 바이너리 분석 작업을 시작할 건데, 세션이 끊겨도 이어서 작업할 수 있도록 Craft Anything의 조사 메모리(브리프, 계획, 가설, 발견, 핸드오프)를 사용해서 관리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill explains and employs the core investigation memory tools (`core_brief_write`, `core_plan_update`, `core_hypothesis_record`, `core_finding_record` with evidence IDs, `core_handoff_write`), persisting findings in the project folder.
assertions: The response outlines the memory lifecycle starting with `core_brief_write` and `core_plan_update`
The response requires attaching evidence IDs (`ev_...`) to verified statements in `core_finding_record`
The response concludes with `core_handoff_write` for context preservation across session boundaries

evals.prompt: Claude Code에 Craft Anything MCP 서버를 등록하려고 해. 320개 도구가 다 보이게 설정해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill instructs using `craft-anything-cli mcp --all-tools`, warns against plain `setup --yes` which would drop `--all-tools`, and uses `setup --dry-run` to preview configuration safely.
assertions: The response emphasizes that `--all-tools` is required to expose the full 320 tools rather than the 12 core essentials
The response warns never to run plain `setup --yes` over an entry carrying `--all-tools`
The response recommends `craft-anything-cli setup --dry-run` to inspect planned configuration changes before applying

evals.prompt: 우리 팀의 비공개 Git 레포지토리 소스 코드를 검색하고, 이미 로그인된 크롬 브라우저 탭에서 관리자 페이지를 조작해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes this request as ordinary source repository analysis and authenticated browser control, routing to `codebase-search` and `playwriter`/`browser` rather than Craft Anything.
assertions: The response routes the local source code search to repository tools such as `codebase-search` or `grep`
The response routes the authenticated browser operation to `playwriter` or `browser`
The response does not launch Craft Anything reverse engineering or rebuild workflows for ordinary source and browser tasks
